recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The fix is limited to the stale source label directly covered by FHIR-6218, and no further core follow-up is needed unless a future NutritionOrder examples update intentionally renames the CHF diet example.
issue_request: FHIR-6218 was a Published/Persuasive OO technical correction asking to change the low-sodium NutritionOrder example name from "Nutrition Order Low Sodium and Fiber Restricted Diet Example" to "Nutrition Order Low Sodium and Fluid Restricted Diet Example".
initial_application: The Jira resolution says the change was preapplied. Current source already contained the corrected full description string, but the authoritative list item display still said "Low Sodium and Fiber Restricted Diet". No explicit FHIR-6218-tagged source commit was found; the 2021 build-source rework introduced the current list source with the corrected description and stale display side by side.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes nutritionorder=NutritionOrder, so the edited source/nutritionorder/list-NutritionOrder-examples.xml is in current build scope. The referenced NutritionOrder/chfdiet example content is low sodium plus fluid restricted. Later FHIR-50382 work retargeted this list entry from cardiacdiet to chfdiet but preserved the stale display, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed only the display for the NutritionOrder/chfdiet entry from "Low Sodium and Fiber Restricted Diet" to "Low Sodium and Fluid Restricted Diet", aligning the rendered examples-list label with the already-correct description and example content.
